title: Ground continuity: seams, pads, road ends, water mask, ground cover, beach sand

items.name: Seam audit tool (tools/v2/seam-audit.mjs + src/world/ground/seamAudit.js): dead-end road finish and step, set-piece pad border steps, collider holes, solid ground over swimmable water, offshore islets, map-wide water-mask slivers; before/after via ?groundfix=0

Audit totals before -> after (5 areas: Nico house, South Beach strip, South Beach lawn, Downtown, Little Havana): abrupt road ends 5 -> 0, pad border steps 117/118 (max 0.88 m) -> 0 (max 0.12 m), solid-over-water 0 -> 0, water-mask slivers still water 16618 samples (~266k m2) -> 0
Nico house yard sits flush on the ground (was a 0.88 m ledge with a seawall face and an open void below); yard sheet sinks into the terrain along a meandering edge on the open sides
Pelican Point Lane ends at the yard with a flared concrete apron (road trimmed at the set-piece ground claim, no road under or over the yard)
Every dead-end road in the map: cul-de-sac bulb (residential, when there is room) or rounded asphalt cap, with colliders; ends inside set-piece ground get the apron
Water-mask slivers (rasterisation gaps between land polygons, e.g. the strip through South Beach where Nico swam under a sand slab) count as land map-wide; ground is drawn and collided over them
Tiny bare sand specks in open water outside real Miami (the slab offshore of the Keys spawn) are open water; dropped from the land base too
Keys / synthetic inland sand fields broken into sand, scrub, meadow and lawn patches (no single brown field); Keys mix gets a second noise scale
Plain land (M.land) is the world-space lawn / sparse grass / dirt blend permanently (from world-dressing patchLand); land base recolored green-brown with variation in tilebuild
Park lawns get macro mowing / dry-patch variation (groundWear on M.grass)

Beaches and dunes use the fine sand material (now 3-scale stochastic sampling + large colour drift) with a waterline moisture field (src/world/ground/beach.v2.js): dry pale sand, damp band, glossy swash line, ripples on dry sand, shells and debris
Terrain flora no longer grows inside set-piece ground claims (bushes in Nico's yard)
GPU deformation map for footprints and tyre tracks (existing decals in src/fx/footprints.v2.js kept: depth normals, rims, damp darkening)
Nico house: the layout's water is ~35 m beyond the yard's seawall, so the seawall and dock face low land (now flush, 0.24 m cap); needs a layout or house-plan decision
sand:fine shader compile fix (groundWear no longer chained onto the fine sand material: wMacro / wStain undefined)
Beach-zone land meeting the sea gets a 26-42 m sand band and a sand slope into the water instead of a dirt lawn ending at a seawall (no seawall stairs on beaches)
G2: synthetic terrain shoreline height follows the local water share (smooth waterline contour, no jagged triangle saw z-fighting the ocean); land stays above sea level
G5: Nico yard puddles toned to muddy rut water (dark, low reflection) instead of sky-blue decals
R1: road ribbons are only cut back for a junction disc that is actually drawn (junctionDrawn mirrors the junction loop), so no grass gaps where the elevated module skips the disc
R2: thin concrete edge strip on open roads, mid-grey asphalt, greener scrub / meadow verges and fewer bare patches in the Keys mix
G3: dock runs from the seawall out to the real waterline on piles, deck 0.28 m (one step), no seawall cap under it
G4: game.surfaceAt returns the structure (wood / paved) when the player stands above the ground there; footprints and landing dust skip decks
Still open: concrete lots with joints and curb strip, less ground grain, orange verge patches on mid-LOD terrain, GPU footprint deformation, R1 proof at the 61.webp spot
